root_cause: Repository Writer Candidate Shadow subscribed to every pull_request and skipped unless the head branch started with writer/. GitHub cannot pre-filter pull_request events by head-ref prefix, so every ordinary PR still created a workflow run that immediately skipped. Several writer creators also relied on this global trigger instead of explicit immutable handoff.
prevention_rule: All canonical repository writers must explicitly dispatch Candidate Shadow after resolving the exact candidate PR base SHA, head SHA and writer branch. Candidate Shadow itself is workflow_dispatch-only. Writer workflow definitions are automation control-plane paths. Adding a new writer requires explicit shadow dispatch regression coverage.

evidence.observed_waste: Repository Writer Candidate Shadow scheduled and concluded skipped on a non-writer PR.
